title: Shrimp Curry
description: A classic Indian-inspired dish made with succulent shrimp and a rich, creamy curry sauce. Serve with steamed basmati rice or naan bread.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the shrimp and cook until pink, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Add the curry sauce, garam masala, and cumin powder. Stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5-7 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Serve hot over steamed basmati rice or naan bread.
